name: Search People
description: Retrieve a collection of person objects ordered by their relevance to the user, based on communication and collaboration patterns and business relationships. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/user-list-people)

configurable_props.name: search
configurable_props.label: Search Query
configurable_props.description: Search for people by name or alias (e.g., 'Jane Smith'). Supports fuzzy matching. Note: Only works for the signed-in user's relevant people.

configurable_props.name: filter
configurable_props.label: Filter
configurable_props.description: Filter people using [OData syntax](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/search/search-query-odata-syntax-reference). Limits response to people matching specified criteria. [See the documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/user-list-people)

configurable_props.name: orderBy
configurable_props.label: Order By
configurable_props.description: Changes the sort order of results. For example, `displayName` or `displayName desc`. Default ordering is by relevance to the user.

configurable_props.name: select
configurable_props.label: Select
configurable_props.description: Comma-separated list of [properties](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/api/resources/person?view=graph-rest-1.0#properties) to include in the response. Recommended for performance optimization.

configurable_props.name: skip
configurable_props.label: Skip
configurable_props.description: Skip the first N results. Note: Not supported with `$search`.

configurable_props.name: maxResults
configurable_props.label: Max Results
configurable_props.description: The maximum number of people to return per page
